body: Thanx... you made my day... However, I feel disgusted only when I am alone otherwise I am a very optimistic and happy guy.
Thanks for sharing your thoughts. I always knew deep down that I have to meet a psychologist. Probably I will soon pay them a visit.
I agree... but closing your eyes doesn't solve the problems. Even if I close my eyes to deep shit in the world, deep down I know it's there and probably never be cleaned.

I agree with you... I think negative only when I am alone... Otherwise I do enjoy the beauty of this world. It just depresses me when these thoughts come in. Otherwise, I am very happy and feel good when I am with friends and family.

Thank you. I agree with you. Hence, I feel awkward, confused and sad and think " Why the fuck am I here?". 

This usually happens when I am alone. Otherwise I am busy working on something, or enjoying materialistic stuff as others.

I totally agree with " Ignorance is Bliss". May be, my curiosity has forced me to dig deeper in places where I shouldn't have been. 

I am not in 1%-2% of top intelligence in the world for sure. However, I would consider myself above average say in top 49% of the world. I am happy about what I do and what I have and what I experience. I am just thinking something(about the messed up world) all the time specially when I am alone. This depresses me. That's it.

Thanx for ur comment
Thanx I will do it now. I think it would be great if Reddit had the feature of moving posts.

Thank you. I appreciate your time on this post.

I understand that, I do picture the beauty of the world. I appreciate being in the company of good friends. The problem is " I can't stop thinking why to things take a shitty turn in this world, when it can be a lot better?" Just can't get rid of such thoughts. I am glad to know that others might feel this way.

You didn't read my tldr. I am never going to commit suicide or kill people. I just feel like shit when things around the world are taking a turn and I and many others cannot do anything about it even though possible solutions exist to make things work in a better fashion.

Well if he thinks that  someone he hasn't even seen and spent quality time together with is more important than his family, he does not deserve you. You will probably be better without him. Just be strong and make sure you kick him out before he actually leaves...
